evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours runtime forensics are unavailable; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
Per-strategy, per-chain realised gross and net P&L after network/priority fees, platform fees, slippage and price impact.
Cost-complete opportunity funnel: observed, eligible, quoted, simulated, submitted, included, reconciled and closed.
Solana follower-sized entry and reverse-exit quote evidence with quote age, Jupiter price impact, priority/network fees and copy latency.
EVM expected-versus-realised gas, quote decay, revert rate, inclusion outcome and route-level realised P&L distributions.
Failure-stage attribution sufficient to distinguish STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
Chronological out-of-sample results with frozen parameters, regime coverage, largest-winner concentration and drawdown.
Money-weighted capital exposure, holding duration, reserve usage and opportunity cost by chain.
No strategy can be described as profitable, CANARY-ready or LIVE-ready until these gaps are filled with fresh, cost-complete evidence.

proposals.downside_risk: Extra quote traffic and conservative round-trip assumptions may reduce apparent opportunities; stale or rate-limited quotes could bias coverage.

evidence.detail: Solana observations intentionally populate gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, latency reserve, liquidity and sellability with zero and mark outcomes SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE.
The entry edge proxy is reconstructed historical leader return rather than a contemporaneous follower executable round-trip quote.

proposals.expected_effect: Permit falsifiable Solana SHADOW evaluation using follower-sized, timestamped entry and reverse-exit quotes with all observable costs and a latency reserve.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible signals across at least 14 independent days, with at least 30 usable round-trip quote observations and separate reporting by mint-liquidity cohort; no promotion without later realised out-of-sample outcomes.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader returns cannot establish follower edge after Jupiter price impact, priority/network fees, copy delay and likely exit costs. This is a STRATEGY/MARKET evidence gap, not proof of an infrastructure failure.
proposals.shadow_test: For each otherwise eligible copied BUY, record a non-signing follower-sized entry quote and immediate reverse-exit quote, priority/network fee estimate, price impact, quote age and signal-to-quote delay. Count an opportunity only when conservative expected round-trip net P&L is positive. Stop and mark the test failed if cost fields are missing, quote coverage is below 90%, or quote collection weakens existing runtime safety paths.
proposals.strategy: Solana leader-copy and cross-chain Strategy Lab families

proposals.downside_risk: Longer evaluation time and more strategies remaining dormant during sparse markets.

evidence.detail: PROMOTION_CANDIDATE can be returned after only three windows, eight trades, positive aggregate net and profit factor at least 1.10.

The executor states quote simulations are not promotion evidence and persists promotion_evidence=0, but Strategy Lab lifecycle thresholds do not themselves enforce a chronological out-of-sample split.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduce false promotion candidates and expose whether apparent edge survives new regimes and chain-specific costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 cost-complete holdout outcomes, five independent windows and coverage of both favourable and adverse market windows; chain-specific promotion evidence rather than pooled Solana/EVM results.
proposals.rationale: Eight aggregated observations can be dominated by one regime, chain or large winner. Durable money-weighted net P&L requires explicit chronological holdout evidence, cost completeness and downside stability.
proposals.shadow_test: Evaluate each strategy with frozen parameters on chronological train/validation/holdout partitions and per-chain cohorts. Require positive holdout net P&L after all recorded costs, profit factor above 1, no single trade contributing more than 50% of holdout net profit, and no unresolved execution failures. Fail on negative holdout net, missing cost attribution, parameter changes during holdout or excessive concentration.

proposals.downside_risk: Classification complexity and possible overuse of UNKNOWN unless stage evidence is mandatory and auditable.

evidence.detail: Windows record execution_failures alongside net profit but do not encode failure stage, counterfactual opportunity value or a loss-cause classification.
A non-positive aggregate net result leads to REPLACE_OR_REWORK without conditioning on unresolved execution or infrastructure failures.
Execution failures are escalated for engineering review, showing intended separation, but the strategy lifecycle decision remains aggregate.

proposals.expected_effect: More accurate STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE diagnosis and fewer inappropriate threshold changes.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 eligible observations per chain with complete terminal classification and at least five observations for any failure class used to infer a systematic infrastructure issue.
proposals.rationale: A sound signal that fails because of quote expiry, RPC failure, transaction construction, revert or inclusion delay should not be classified identically to a filled trade whose market move produced a loss. Conversely, infrastructure explanations must not excuse filled negative-edge trades.
proposals.shadow_test: Assign every eligible observation exactly one terminal class: no executable edge, strategy/market loss after successful execution, execution failure by stage, successful net profit, or unknown. Compare strategy decisions using successfully executable outcomes while separately reporting failure-adjusted opportunity cost. Fail if classes do not reconcile to total observations or if UNKNOWN exceeds 5%.
proposals.strategy: Strategy Lab attribution and replacement decisions

proposals.downside_risk: Gas-multiple and flat retained-net floors may reject profitable low-margin routes or behave differently across EVM chains; only runtime opportunity-cost evidence can justify tuning.

evidence.detail: Candidates fail closed on scanner verification, liquidity, route approval, product policy and quarantine, then receive wallet-specific simulation before execution.
Expected net profit must clear a configurable multiple of estimated gas, providing chain-native economic scaling.
Realised result uses wrapped-balance change minus actual receipt gas and records fee settlement separately.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserve conservative atomic execution economics while runtime evidence is gathered.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 cost-complete opportunities per materially traded EVM chain and 30 receipt-confirmed executions before considering threshold changes.
proposals.rationale: The architecture correctly treats gas and execution verification as part of edge and records receipt-confirmed money-weighted outcomes. This does not prove the strategy profitable without fresh runtime distributions.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay rejected and accepted opportunities without broadcasting using contemporaneous quotes and actual-equivalent gas assumptions. Compare predicted net with later executable quote decay and, for historical fills, realised net. Stop if cost fields are incomplete or simulations are not timestamp-aligned.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower net-edge, liquidity, sellability, simulation or gas-multiple gates to increase trade count.
rejected_ideas.reason: No fresh evidence shows forgone opportunities are positive after costs; higher frequency is not the objective.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any current Strategy Lab family based on architectural checks or quote simulations.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are missing and quote simulations are explicitly non-promotional evidence.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all negative P&L as a strategy defect.
rejected_ideas.reason: The current evidence cannot separate filled market losses from RPC, quote, simulation, construction, inclusion or reconciliation failures.

rejected_ideas.idea: Pool Solana and EVM outcomes into one profitability claim.
rejected_ideas.reason: Their fee models, latency, liquidity, transaction semantics and present evidence coverage differ materially.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository correctly prioritises cost-adjusted edge, fail-closed execution checks and money-weighted results over raw wins. EVM execution includes fresh wallet-specific simulation, gas-relative profit floors and receipt-confirmed realised P&L. Solana safety and realised-amount gates are substantial, but its Strategy Lab adapter deliberately lacks contemporaneous executable edge, making Solana profitability untestable in the supplied evidence. Promotion governance also needs stronger out-of-sample enforcement and explicit separation of strategy/market losses from execution/infrastructure failures. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is supported.
